about_the_game:
“Touhou Fantalica” is a 2D shooting game based on the Touhou Project.
It combines the world of Touhou with classic arcade-style shoot-'em-up gameplay, featuring charming pixel-art characters and a nostalgic retro design.

Story

Reimu finds herself pulled into a magical book that Marisa brought back.

As she ventures through this mysterious world, familiar faces from Gensokyo appear one after another.
They too seem to have been caught up in the book’s magic, and now take on the roles of storybook characters—though something about them feels a little... different.

Can Reimu make her way out of this strange world and return home safely?

Switch Between Shots and Bombs

Your attacks are divided into Shots and Bombs. Use Shots against airborne enemies and Bombs against ground enemies.
Since different attacks won’t hit the wrong targets, it’s important to switch depending on the enemy’s position!

Boost Panels

Hit the Boost Panels to change their effect!
Keep shooting until you get the effect you want.
But be careful—while you’re focusing on the panels, more enemies will appear around you!

Playable Characters

  • Hakurei Reimu

Story Characters

  • Kirisame Marisa

  • Reisen Udongein Inaba
    …and more to come!
